content_sections.heading: BKNMU Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: For posts at Level-8 and above, if applicants exceed six, a written test is held first; the top six scorers are called for interview. For Lab Assistant and Store Keeper (Advt 9/2026), and Senior Clerk and Junior Clerk (Advt 10/2026), only a written test is conducted (no interview). For Librarian, selection is as per the Gujarat Public Universities Uniform Statutes-2024 and UGC Regulations, 2018. Syllabus and exam pattern (where a written test applies) will be published on the university website.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for BKNMU Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Apply online at https://bknmurms.gipl.in/ on or before 16/10/2026. Pay the prescribed application fee online. Print the completed application and attach it, along with self-attested documents (in the order set out in Annexure-I) and Annexure-II (if already employed), to two hardcopies. Send both hardcopies in a single envelope to: The Registrar, Bhakta Kavi Narsinh Mehta University, Government Polytechnic Campus, Bhakta Kavi Narsinh Mehta University Road, Khadiya, Junagadh-362263, by Courier/In Person/Registered Post/Speed Post, so as to reach on or before 21/10/2026, 6:00 p.m. Applications sent only by email will not be accepted.

faq.question: Q1. What is BKNMU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a set of recruitment drives by Bhakta Kavi Narsinh Mehta University, Junagadh, for a Librarian post (Advt 8/2026) and Non-Teaching/Administrative posts (Advt 9/2026 and Advt 10/2026).

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: 7 vacancies are currently active under Advt 8/2026 and 9/2026 combined (Librarian, Internal Audit Officer, Assistant Engineer-Electrical, Assistant Civil Engineer, Lab Assistant, Assistant Registrar, Store Keeper). 4 additional vacancies under Advt 10/2026 (System Analyst, Senior Clerk, 2 Junior Clerk) are cancelled, pending Government approval.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The online application closes on 16/10/2026; hardcopies must reach the University by 21/10/2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required?
faq.answer: It varies by post - ranging from Graduation (Junior Clerk) to a Ph.D. with 10 years' experience (Librarian). See the eligibility section above for post-wise details.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: Age limits range from 35 years (Junior Clerk) to 57 years with relaxations (Librarian), and 40-45 years for most other posts.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: ₹1,500 for Unreserved candidates and ₹750 for SC/ST/SEBC/EWS candidates; PwBD candidates are exempted subject to conditions.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply online?
faq.answer: Through the official portal at https://bknmurms.gipl.in/, followed by submission of hardcopies as described above.
